patch.summary:
Choose BMC Helix ITSM only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ITSM (Helix / Remedy lineage) — no BMC.com list; AppExchange signal ~$114.75/na” rather than Fly.io's shape. Choose Fly.io only if your buying job matches “Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regio” rather than BMC Helix ITSM's shape. Workflow advantage: BMC Helix ITSM leans itsm-service-desk; Fly.io leans cloud-paas. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: BMC Helix ITSM is Enterprise ITSM (Helix / Remedy lineage) — no BMC.com list; AppExchange signal ~$114.75/named user/mo. Always RFP. Does not outrank ServiceN; Fly.io is Cloud PaaS / microVM app platform — PAYG; shared-cpu-1x from ~$1.94/mo in lower-cost regions. Support Standard $29/mo is support, not hostin.
- Company-size focus: BMC Helix ITSM (mid-market, enterprise) vs Fly.io (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: BMC Helix ITSM-leaning itsm-service-desk vs Fly.io-leaning cloud-paas.
- Researched limits: BMC Helix ITSM — No BMC.com price card — $115 is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU; Fly.io — Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award.

Limitations — BMC Helix ITSM: No BMC.com price card — $115 is an AppExchange named-user signal, not a vendor SKU; Does not outrank ServiceNow (8.7); Fly.io: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award; Support Standard $29/mo is support — not the hosting floor.
